selection_basis: Actual JS COMBVD and synthetic constant-R/constant-L Oklab path screens; prefer fine200 over lower-STRESS fits for stronger smoothing on both axes. No new ColorBench human-data judges have been evaluated yet.
training: COMBVD + synthetic inverse-path regularization; no OSA/MacAdam1974/Xiao/threshold/tolerance training
parameter_change: Three full R/L layers, 195 coefficients; native sRGB coefficients and all physical/hue/neutral definitions unchanged.
